# Wails documentation routes

> A community-authored navigation index for Wails v2 and v3. Fetch the linked
> upstream content when working; this file does not contain an API snapshot.

Select the major version from the project's Go module, including replacements.
Live docs and master source may be newer than the installed version. Confirm APIs
against local source or the matching release tag/commit before implementing.
This index is not an official Wails publication and is not an exhaustive catalog.

## Wails v3

- [Official live llms.txt](https://v3.wails.io/llms.txt): Fetch this first to discover the current page catalog.
- [Documentation home](https://v3.wails.io/): Rediscover navigation if individual links move.
- [Official markdown source directory](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/tree/master/docs/mpress/content): Discover raw pages when HTML retrieval fails; paths are not a stable API.
- [Raw documentation navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/docs/mpress/content/_nav.yaml): Current source navigation, including topic and route structure.
- [Raw installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/docs/mpress/content/quick-start/installation.md): Toolchain and platform prerequisites; inspect before running any setup.
- [Raw application reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/docs/mpress/content/reference/application.md): Application APIs on upstream master; verify against the resolved module.
- [Raw frontend runtime reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/docs/mpress/content/reference/frontend-runtime.md): Frontend integration on upstream master.
- [Raw v2 to v3 migration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/docs/mpress/content/migration/v2-to-v3.md): Read only for a requested or evaluated migration.

## Wails v2

- [Documentation introduction](https://wails.io/docs/introduction/): Official v2 documentation entry point.
- [Official MDX source directory](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/tree/master/website/docs): Discover current v2 docs without scraping the site.
- [Raw introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/website/docs/introduction.mdx): Overview and links into the v2 documentation.
- [Raw installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/website/docs/gettingstarted/installation.mdx): Version-specific platform prerequisites.
- [Raw CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/website/docs/reference/cli.mdx): v2 command documentation; compare with installed CLI help.
- [Raw application options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/website/docs/reference/options.mdx): v2 application configuration.
- [Raw runtime overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wailsapp/wails/master/website/docs/reference/runtime/intro.mdx): v2 Go and JavaScript runtime navigation.

## Version and path discovery

- [Official repository](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails): Rediscover documentation locations and source ownership.
- [Repository metadata API](https://api.github.com/repos/wailsapp/wails): Discover the current default branch instead of assuming master forever.
- [Official releases](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/releases): Resolve release status and exact tags; do not upgrade the project automatically.
- [v2 package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2): Select the project's exact module version before relying on APIs.
- [v3 application package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/pkg/application): Select the project's exact module version before relying on APIs.
